name: Yukemuri! Imouto × Kikou
source:
Cute, somewhat precocious little sister and your travel diary at the hot spring!

I was sure I'd be having a date with my first girlfriend, but my little sister ended up coming instead...!

Now it's just me and my sister in a hot, romantic, steamy onsen!?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ087548.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
可爱又有点早熟的小姐姐和你的温泉旅行日记！

原本以为要和初恋女友约会，结果妹妹却来了……！

现在只有我和我妹妹在炎热、浪漫、热气腾腾的温泉里！？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ087548.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
